macros.name: fgruler
macros.doc: It draws a square ruler on the foreground of that page, where this command is expanded.

macros.name: fgrulercaptioncm
macros.doc: Unit caption in metric ruler.

macros.name: fgrulercaptionin
macros.doc: Unit caption in English ruler.

macros.name: fgrulercolorcm
macros.doc: Mark colors in metric rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: fgrulercolorin
macros.doc: Mark color in English rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: fgrulernoborderline
macros.doc: By default, there is a borderline on one side of the ruler. It disappears by this command.

macros.name: fgrulerratiocm
macros.doc: Mark length ratios in metric rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: fgrulerratioin
macros.doc: Mark length ratios in English rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: fgrulerreset
macros.doc: It sets all options and parameters to default values.

macros.name: fgrulerstartnum
macros.doc: The ⟨num⟩ is a nonnegative integer, which will be the starting number on the horizontal and vertical rulers.

macros.name: fgrulerstartnumh
macros.doc: The ⟨num⟩ is a nonnegative integer, which will be the starting number on the horizontal rulers.

macros.name: fgrulerstartnumv
macros.doc: The ⟨num⟩ is a nonnegative integer, which will be the starting number on the vertical rulers.

macros.name: fgrulerthickcm
macros.doc: Mark thicknesses in metric rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: fgrulerthickin
macros.doc: Mark thicknesses in English rulers. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: ruler
macros.doc: It draws a horizontal or a vertical ruler.

macros.name: rulernorotatenum
macros.doc: By default, the numbers of the vertical rulers (which were generated by \ruler or \squareruler) are rotated by 90◦ . It kills this action.

macros.name: rulerparams
macros.doc: It sets the parameters of the rulers, which are drawn by \ruler or \squareruler. If an argument is empty, then that parameter will not be changed.

macros.name: rulerparamsfromfg
macros.doc: It sets the ruler parameters from the current foreground ruler parameters.

macros.name: rulerrotatenum
macros.doc: After \rulernorotatenum, it reactivates the number rotating.

macros.name: squareruler
macros.doc: It draws a square ruler.
